title: Machine Learning
description: A map of the assumptions that let machines improve from experience.

content.text: Machine learning is less a single technique than a change in how we write programs: we describe the experience, the objective, and the constraints, then let a model discover a useful mapping.

Every learning system has data, a model class, and a loss function. The interesting work is often in the seams between them: what the data leaves out, what the model can express, and which mistakes the loss function makes expensive.

content.title: Working definition
content.text: Learning is controlled improvement against an objective, under assumptions that should be made visible.
When a model generalizes, it is not simply remembering less. It is finding structure that survives a change in context. That makes evaluation part of the research, not a final ceremony.
